user.title: Isolectra Streda
user.description:
Connects to the Zigbee2MQTT of your Streda box. Add the MQTT integration first, with your Streda box's IP address and port 1883.

This integration only reads from the box; it sends a command only when you switch a device.

data_description.base_topic: Leave at zigbee2mqtt unless your box uses another topic.

error.no_device_list: No device list received on this topic within 10 seconds. Is MQTT connected to the Streda box, and is the base topic correct?

abort.already_configured: This Streda box is already set up.
abort.mqtt_not_connected: The MQTT integration is not set up or not connected. Add MQTT first, with your Streda box's IP address and port 1883.
